description: Create a product listing from its public URL and a subcategory. Name, title, description, logo, video_url (first YouTube/Vimeo/Loom link), and up to 5 screenshots are filled from the page when omitted; screenshots takes [{ data }] (base64 or data URL) and [] skips autofill, video_url empty string skips the video. The stored URL is the final address after redirects. free_for_now marks a free product so zero MRR shows as Free for now. Ownership verify (DNS TXT or /.well-known/dealpuffin-verification) is optional.

categories.description: Up to 5 subcategory slugs; replaces category when set.

free_for_now.description: When true, zero MRR proof readings show as Free for now instead of $0 or 0-1k.

screenshots.description: Up to 5 images as { data } (base64 or data URL; JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP; 10 MB). Omit to autofill from the page; [] for none.

video_url.description: YouTube, Vimeo, or Loom link. Omit to autofill from the page; empty string for none.

name: submit_product
